name: lecture-notes-to-revision-sheet
title_zh: Outline 笔记原地生成可打印的复习卡
tagline_zh: 不用复制粘贴、不用换软件，在 Outline 里选中笔记就能生成复习卡。支持中英法文指令，笔记改了能自动更新。
tagline_en: No copy-paste, no app-switching: turn any Outline note into a cram-ready revision sheet. Handles EN/FR/CN.
desc_en: Use when asked for a revision sheet, study sheet, exam sheet, cram sheet or "fiche de révision" built from lecture notes that already live in Outline -- including phrasings like "fais une fiche de révision de la Lecture 3", "make a revision sheet for this lecture on outline", "fiches pour réviser le cours X", "add a study sheet under that note", "régénère la fiche", or "the note changed, update it
why_zh: 它不搬内容，而是重排结构：把大纲层级压成考点、定义、易错点，产物是能直接打印的 A4 版式。
why_en: It doesn't copy content—it restructures outline hierarchy into exam-ready sections (key points, definitions, pitfalls) and.
limit_zh: 只认 Outline 里的笔记，不支持 PDF/Word 导入；只生成单页复习卡，不负责做闪卡或测验题。
limit_en: Only works on notes already in Outline (no PDF/Word import). Outputs a single-page sheet only—no flashcards or quizzes. Truncates if note exceeds 50.
title_en: Turn Outline notes into printable revision sheets
